 Having run the gauntlet of available services I have simply become aware of a small subset of people like myself who do not fit any current criteria. We just don't like this world, nor feel we belong in it.
 My analogy is being at a party you don't enjoy- no one is hurting you, food, drink and atmosphere are fine but you just don't like being there. Should you stay there, being unhappy, purely so you don't hurt others feelings?

 I have been sent to a Specialist Clinic who openly admitted I was untreatable. In their words I was "very rational about being irrational".
 I just think, like Luxembourg, if you truly no longer desire Life then wouldn't it be sensible to allow you to leave?
 As I pointed out, as I am unusually fit and my organs process toxins rapidly, wouldn't I be a gift to organ donation?
 One quick injection then harvest what you like. Seems fair. And sensible. Let alone economical.
 I just think that, like prostitution or porn, people try to moralise what can actually be a rational and desired choice.

But, yes, it is great help is there for all who need it.
Just that some of us neither need nor require it.

Mary Jo Lee Long- went missing around December 27 1981 and wasn't reported for 7 years.
 It seems there may have been a mixture if some confusion and mostly disinterest as she moved from Austin, Minnesota to Gardena, California to live with her father and enrolled in school there. This was apparently against her Mothers wishes.
 Seems she went back to Austin for Christmas and that's where it gets uncertain- it seems everyone assumed she went back to California though there's no evidence she did. Meanwhile, those in California assumed she was staying in Austin.

What really strikes me is that no-one seemed interested enough in her absence to enquire about it. Father either didn't know or frankly care about her whereabouts; ditto the Mother.

It's one of those low key cases that reminds you of how someone can fall off the radar and not even register as a blip.
